diagnostic_scenario.kind: accelerated irradiation model, not a mission
diagnostic_scenario.ion: 57Fe, 16.3 MeV/n, normal incidence, delidded, room temperature
diagnostic_scenario.flux_basis: lower end of RADEF continuous heavy-ion facility range in Coronetti 2020 III.D; not the flux reported for the particular Table IX run
diagnostic_scenario.horizon_basis: one-hour engineering observation interval; not a mission allocation
diagnostic_scenario.epsilon_basis: explicit 10% research design ceiling for first E_cap; no flight requirement or borrowing of old radiation normalization
diagnostic_scenario.response_transfer: nominal same-response model for three identical parts; equal sensitivity of all physical bit cells is an assumption
diagnostic_scenario.spatial_layout: three separate chips, common address, 16+16 data and 7 parity lanes, 9 ignored padding lanes

witness.semantics: toggle, absorbing first two distinct error positions

reason_no_controller_parameters: The radiation mean is calculable; the marked arrival/count law and a budget for excluded grouped paths remain unclosed. No CTMC is fitted or policy tuning undertaken at this stage.
